q_gram_c2_14_004.correct: It converts verbs into nouns to create more formal, impersonal, and information-dense prose typical of scientific writing
wrong: It simplifies complex ideas by replacing long verb phrases with shorter noun equivalents
It is primarily a stylistic choice with no functional difference from using verb phrases
It makes texts more accessible to non-specialist readers by eliminating technical verb forms
q_gram_c2_14_004.explanation: Nominalization (turning 动词 into 名词: obtener → la obtención) 是 a hallmark 的 academic register 在 西班牙语. 它 serves multiple functions: increasing information density, enabling impersonal expression, allowing 名词 phrases 到 serve as grammatical subjects, 和 creating 正式 tone expected 在 scholarly writing.

q_gram_c2_14_005.question: Los resultados ___ sugerir que existe una correlación significativa entre ambas variables. (parecer, 现在陈述式, hedging)
q_gram_c2_14_005.explanation: 'Parecer + 不定式' 是 a 关键 hedging device 在 academic 西班牙语, softening claims 到 avoid categorical assertions. 'Los resultados parecen sugerir' ( results seem 到 suggest) 是 doubly hedged — 两者 'parecen' 和 'sugerir' attenuate claim. 复数 'parecen' agrees 与 'los resultados'.
q_gram_c2_14_005.conjugation_info: parecer (present): parezco, pareces, parece, parecemos, parecéis, parecen

q_gram_c2_14_006.question: A partir de los hallazgos, se ___ la necesidad de ampliar el estudio a una población más diversa.
q_gram_c2_14_006.explanation: 'Se constata la necesidad' uses impersonal passive 'se' 与 a 单数 动词 因为 'la necesidad' 是 单数. 'Constatar' (到 verify/establish) 是 a 正式 academic 动词. present tense conveys conclusion as a current finding derived 来自 research.
q_gram_c2_14_006.hint: 动词 必须 agree 与 单数 subject 'la necesidad'

q_gram_c2_14_007.question: Further research 是 needed 到 determine long-term effects 的 这 intervention.
q_gram_c2_14_007.correct: Se requiere investigación adicional para determinar los efectos a largo plazo de esta intervención.
wrong: Más investigación es necesitada para determinar los efectos a largo plazo de esta intervención.
Necesitamos más investigación para determinar los efectos de largo plazo de esta intervención.
Es necesario que se investigue más para que se determinen los efectos a largo tiempo de esta intervención.
q_gram_c2_14_007.explanation: Academic 西班牙语 avoids 英语 passive '是 needed' 和 uses 'se requiere' (impersonal se). 'Investigación adicional' 是 preferred over 'más investigación' 在 正式 registers. 'A largo plazo' 是 正确 fixed expression 为 'long-term', not 'de largo plazo' 或 'a largo tiempo'.

q_gram_c2_14_008.question: Tal y como se ___ en la sección anterior, las limitaciones metodológicas deben tenerse en cuenta al interpretar estos datos.
q_gram_c2_14_008.explanation: 'Tal y como se mencionó en la sección anterior' (as 是 mentioned 在 previous section) uses impersonal 'se' 与 简单过去时 到 refer 到 a specific earlier point 在 text. 简单过去时 是 preferred 这里 因为 mention occurred at a definite point, unlike 未完成过去时 which 将 imply an ongoing 或 repeated action.
q_gram_c2_14_008.hint: 使用 简单过去时 为 a specific past reference within text

q_gram_c2_14_009.question: No se han hallado diferencias estadísticamente significativas entre los grupos experimentales y el grupo de control.
q_gram_c2_14_009.correct: No statistically significant differences have been found between the experimental groups and the control group.
wrong: Statistically significant differences have not been found between the groups of experiment and the group of control.
There were no differences of statistical significance between the experimental groups and the controlling group.
Significant statistical differences were not encountered between the experimental and the control groups.
q_gram_c2_14_009.explanation: 'Se han hallado' (现在完成时 与 impersonal 'se') translates 到 passive '有 been found'. 'Estadísticamente significativas' 是 a fixed academic collocation 含义 'statistically significant'. 'Grupo de control' = 'control group' (not 'controlling group').

q_gram_c2_14_010.question: Sería conveniente que futuras investigaciones ___ estas variables con una muestra más amplia. (abordar, 过去虚拟式, 正式 recommendation)
q_gram_c2_14_010.explanation: 'Sería conveniente que' (它 将 是 advisable 那) triggers 过去虚拟式 因为 main clause 是 在 条件式. 'Abordaran' 是 -ra 形式的 过去虚拟式. 在 academic writing, 这 structure 是 用过的 为 recommendations. 注意: 'abordasen' 是 也 grammatically valid 但是 -ra 形式 是 标准 在 academic prose.
q_gram_c2_14_010.conjugation_info: abordar (imperfect subjunctive): abordara, abordaras, abordara, abordáramos, abordarais, abordaran

q_gram_c2_15_001.question: Si yo ___ tú, no aceptaría esa oferta. (ser, 过去虚拟式 — a basic 条件式 structure reviewed at mastery level)
q_gram_c2_15_001.explanation: 'Si yo fuera tú' (if I 是 你) uses 过去虚拟式 在 si-clause 的 a present contrary-到-fact 条件式. 这 是 one 的 最 fundamental structures 在 西班牙语, 第一 encountered at B1-B2 但是 需要 complete mastery at C2. 条件式 'aceptaría' follows 在 main clause.
q_gram_c2_15_001.hint: Contrary-到-fact conditionals 需要 过去虚拟式 在 si-clause

q_gram_c2_15_002.question: Habiéndose ___ todas las pruebas, el juez dictó sentencia. (presentar, 过去分词 在 absolute participial clause)
q_gram_c2_15_002.explanation: absolute participial clause 'habiéndose presentado todas las pruebas' (所有 evidence 有 been presented) uses compound 动名词: habiendo + 过去分词. 与 reflexive 'se', 它 becomes 'habiéndose presentado'. 这 是 an advanced literary construction 那 compresses a temporal subordinate clause.

q_gram_c2_15_003.question: 什么 是 difference between 'ser aburrido' 和 'estar aburrido'?
q_gram_c2_15_003.correct: 'Ser aburrido' means 'to be boring' (inherent quality), while 'estar aburrido' means 'to be bored' (temporary state)
wrong: Both mean 'to be bored' but 'ser' is more formal than 'estar'
'Ser aburrido' means 'to be bored' and 'estar aburrido' means 'to be boring'
'Ser aburrido' is used for people and 'estar aburrido' is used for things
q_gram_c2_15_003.explanation: ser/estar distinction 与 形容词 是 fundamental. 与 'aburrido': ser describes an inherent 特征 (Juan es aburrido = Juan 是 a boring 人称), 当...时 estar describes a 状态 或 条件 (Juan está aburrido = Juan 是 bored right now). 这 A2-level concept 必须 是 fully mastered 由 C2.

q_gram_c2_15_004.question: A no ser que se ___ medidas urgentes, la crisis se agravará irreversiblemente. (tomar, 现在虚拟式)
q_gram_c2_15_004.explanation: 'A no ser que' (unless) 总是 triggers 虚拟式. 由于 main clause uses future ('se agravará'), subordinate clause takes 现在虚拟式 'tomen'. impersonal 'se' 与 复数 'medidas' 需要 复数 形式. 这 tests mastery across 虚拟式 triggers, tense sequencing, 和 impersonal constructions.
q_gram_c2_15_004.conjugation_info: tomar (present subjunctive): tome, tomes, tome, tomemos, toméis, tomen

q_gram_c2_15_005.question: El informe, ___ conclusiones fueron cuestionadas por varios expertos, ha sido revisado por completo.
q_gram_c2_15_005.explanation: 'Cuyas' 是 女性 复数 relative possessive 代词, agreeing 与 'conclusiones' (女性 复数), not 与 'el informe' (男性). 'Cuyo/a/os/as' agrees 与 thing possessed, not possessor. 'Que sus' 是 ungrammatical 在 标准 西班牙语 relative clauses.
q_gram_c2_15_005.hint: relative possessive 必须 agree 在 性别 和 数 与 possessed 名词

q_gram_c2_15_006.question: De haberlo ___ antes, habríamos tomado otra decisión. (saber, 过去分词 — mixed 条件式 与 compound 不定式)
q_gram_c2_15_006.explanation: 'De haberlo sabido' (had we known 它) 是 a compressed 条件式 structure equivalent 到 'Si lo hubiéramos sabido'. compound 不定式 'haber + 过去分词' replaces full si-clause. 这 是 a C1-C2 construction 那 combines knowledge 的 conditionals, 不定式 clauses, 和 clitic placement.
q_gram_c2_15_006.conjugation_info: saber (past participle): sabido; compound 不定式: haber sabido

q_gram_c2_15_007.question: Sea ___ sea el resultado, aceptaremos la decisión del tribunal.
q_gram_c2_15_007.explanation: 'Sea cual sea' (whatever/whichever... may 是) 是 a fixed concessive construction 使用 duplicated 现在虚拟式 的 'ser'. interrogative 代词 'cual' 是 仅 正确 option 在 这 structure. 这 formula 是 用过的 across 所有 registers 用来表达 indifference 到 outcome.

q_gram_c2_15_008.question: Had 它 not been 为 你的 help, we 将 not 有 succeeded.
q_gram_c2_15_008.correct: De no haber sido por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
wrong: Si no hubiera sido por tu ayuda, no tuviéramos éxito.
Si no fuera por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
De no ser por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
q_gram_c2_15_008.explanation: 'Had 它 not been 为' 需要 past counterfactual: 'De no haber sido por' (compound 不定式 construction). 'De no ser por' 将 意思 '是 它 not 为' (present counterfactual). main clause uses 条件式 perfect 'habríamos tenido éxito' (将 有 succeeded).

q_gram_c2_15_009.question: Por mucho que se lo ___ , nunca nos hizo caso. (repetir, 过去虚拟式, nosotros form — concessive clause 与 quantifier)
q_gram_c2_15_009.explanation: 'Por mucho que' (no matter 如何 much) triggers 虚拟式. 过去虚拟式 'repitiéramos' 是 需要 因为 main clause 是 在 简单过去时 ('hizo'). 注意 词根 改变: repetir → repit- 在 虚拟式 (来自 第三 人称 简单过去时 词根 'repitió'). clitic 'se lo' precedes conjugated 动词.
q_gram_c2_15_009.conjugation_info: repetir (imperfect subjunctive): repitiera, repitieras, repitiera, repitiéramos, repitierais, repitieran

q_gram_c2_15_010.question: Dicho sea de paso, no es la primera vez que se incumple el protocolo establecido, lo cual pone en entredicho la credibilidad de la institución.
q_gram_c2_15_010.correct: Incidentally, it is not the first time that the established protocol has been breached, which calls into question the institution's credibility.
wrong: Said in passing, it is not the first time they don't comply with the established protocol, which puts in between-said the credibility of the institution.
By the way, it is not the first time that the established protocol is unfulfilled, the which puts into question the credibility of the institution.
That said in passing, this is not the first time the protocol was not complied with, which casts doubt on the institution's credibility.
q_gram_c2_15_010.explanation: 'Dicho sea de paso' 是 a fixed parenthetical expression 含义 'incidentally / 由 way'. 'Se incumple' (impersonal se + present) translates as '有 been breached' 到 capture resultative 含义. 'Poner en entredicho' 是 an idiom 含义 '到 call into question / 到 undermine'. 这 sentence tests mastery 的 multiple advanced structures simultaneously.
